title: pi's credential grep and credentials.Get read ~/.ticfacrc differently
description:
credentials.Get trims spaces around the key and '=' and takes the first match. pi's !grep command needs an exact '^factory_cloudflare_api_token=' and returns every match. Failing input: a hand-edited 'factory_cloudflare_api_token = …'. localMetering builds the join, pi sends an empty credential, and every Workers AI dispatch is refused instead of just going unmetered. A duplicated key line produces a two-line header value.
evidence: internal/credentials/credentials.go:173-182; internal/exec/subprocess/pimeter.go:152
